message.content: In one of the conversations, Jennifer provides several actionable tips to help LiHua boost his endurance. She suggests incorporating longer cardio sessions and interval training into his routine, as these can significantly enhance his physical capabilities. Jennifer recommends mixing up his activities, such as cycling, running, or swimming, to keep the workouts engaging and avoid boredom. Additionally, she emphasizes the importance of proper hydration and nutrition, highlighting that these factors play a crucial role in maintaining endurance and overall fitness.
